steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for this case.
Open the awarding page for the closed two-bid event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor A, the non-lowest bidder.
Verify one line is fully allocated to one of two vendors and the proposal value is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the award proposal so it can be reviewed by the approver.
Confirm the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.
